title: Jaw Dropping Smoky Moroccan Ground Poppy Seeds Seffa
description: A traditional Moroccan dish with a smoky twist, featuring ground poppy seeds and a blend of spices, this seffa is perfect for special occasions, this smoky moroccan seffa is a show stopping dish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the ground poppy seeds, smoked paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked onion and garlic to the bowl and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the seffa from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
